name: Freelance-platform identity verification is not an employment background check

attribution.legal_posture: This is first-party platform-control or threat-research guidance normalized as defensive context; identity attribution and control effectiveness require separate evidence.

caveats: A platform badge confirms the represented check. Work history, sole account control, physical work location, and freedom from identity lending require separate evidence.
The documented feature or policy is optional or scope-limited; identity, location, employment history, and account control require separate evidence.

statements: Upwork prohibits use from North Korea and uses ongoing identity verification, but explicitly distinguishes its verification badge from a traditional employment background check.
limitations: A platform badge should not be treated as proof of work history, sole account control, physical work location, or freedom from identity lending.
